launch: fresh isolated `claude -p` under sandbox-exec, --setting-sources '' --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config with ONLY the shared turbovector MCP server (one vector index built across all 14 pinned repos), --allowedTools mcp__turbovector__* and --disallowedTools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Grep,Glob,...
surface_pure_note: Arm surface is Opus 5 with ONLY the turbovector vector-search MCP server (search, get_file, read_lines, index_info) against a single turbovec/TurboQuant index built across all 14 pinned repos. The server answers every call from the index and its chunk store and never opens a checkout, so retrieval is embedding similarity end to end. Bash/Read/Grep/Glob/Write/Edit and every other MCP server are excluded by --disallowedTools and --strict-mcp-config, so a filesystem-grep escape was not merely unused but impossible. Any tool outside the turbovector allow-list counts as a surface violation.

sandbox.mechanism: sandbox-exec (macOS seatbelt), profile pinned at sandbox.sb
sandbox.note: The benchmark tree is denied wholesale and only the 14 repo directories plus cross-repo/_indexes/turbovec (the turbovector MCP server's own vector index) are re-allowed, so golden.json, DONOTREADTHISFOLDER/ and every sibling arm's results fail with EPERM. ~/.claude/projects is denied too, so no earlier session transcript - nor this run's own - is readable. cwd was a fresh empty directory, no settings sources were loaded and slash commands were disabled, so no CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins or hooks applied; auto-memory is unreadable under the sandbox.

index.build: one cross-repo index: every tracked source file in all 14 pinned repos cut into 20-line windows at stride 15, embedded 384-d (normalized) and stored in a turbovec IdMapIndex at 4-bit; the chunk text is kept in chunks.jsonl so the server never reads a checkout (shared across every cross-repo case, built once)
